signature: Append landscape_authority=None to build(...) and RoadBLDRun.__init__(...). Pass a bound method of the active GeoCityRun; no new positional arguments required.
callback: No arguments. Parent guard must pass; native_road_phase must be authoring. Resolve the exact current Landscape with the parent's official_landscapes(self.wrapper) helper, requiring exactly one. Return {'actor': current_native_actor, 'evidence': fields below}. Never infer from actor name/suffix/order.

evidence.accounted_previous_landscape_paths: sorted self.state['previous_landscape_accounting']['live_actor_paths']; this is the pre-operation exact accounted list, not a new inventory-based approval

consumer_checks: Require callback bound to the active lifecycle parent; verify parent guard, lease, source profile and current operation/phase. Compare supplied fields with run.plan and parent. Require exact loaded Landscape object identity, same named package/world and exact loaded HDA owner. Reject every other loaded Landscape not in the parent-accounted prior list. Freeze actor/operation/owner/evidence on first resolution before native authoring, revalidate it in subsequent samplers.
uses: RoadBLDRun.start resolves before presets/network spawn; LandscapeSampler(run) in clip_final_geometry and grounding.correction consumes the same authority. No call-site change to grounding.correction. LandscapeSampler(run,saved=True) keeps final singleton safety after parent scoped prior-output retirement.
state_receipt: current_landscape_authority contains JSON evidence only; UObject/callback handles remain on the live run, never JSON.
